input.prompt:
Make a genuine transparent game-sprite atlas for the single original Ember Phoenix Wing equipment for 灵葫大作战. Exactly nine poses shown, arranged in the 3 by 3 image reference order. Native square 1536x1536, nine strictly regular 512px square cells, centers at x=256,768,1280 and y=256,768,1280. Every pose has at least 44 px air to every cell edge, with the longest dimension 370–408px. The nine sprites are alone: genuinely transparent background, no panel, checker pattern, grid, writing, letters, dust, highlights floating off object, glitter, body, hands, mount, shadows or unrelated object. Give the viewer pure outline and clean physical shapes. All shown shapes are original crisp, hand-painted 2D Daoist Q style with warm upper-left light, mature rounded forms and minimal fine noise, especially designed for readable small world pixels.

Reference 1 is the nine actual position silhouettes only. Match each cell in that exact position and its proportion, lean, feather direction, right/left-sidedness, and which feathers are visible. Ignore all its text and dark board. Reference 2 is our original inventory identity, use the same tapered vermilion–amber enamel feathers, warm layered gold volume and gold curled ruyi root. Do not simply repeat the inventory shape. Ref 3–4 style references for materials only. Think of it as the same original outfit shown in three wing poses from three observed view patterns. Row 1 is six-feather left-facing outward wing half; row 3 is its opposite direction with its own warm upper-left painted lighting. Row 2 is exactly three distinct mirrored bilateral sets, each with two identical-material halves and a broad transparent U or V-shaped central opening. Leftmost pair is expanded, middle is medium, rightmost is narrow and nearly vertical. All wing feathers flare in the same direction as the reference slot, not as random flames.

1 top-left raw slot 00, narrow upright single left wing, width 0.60 × height (about 240×400). Rounded top, close hugging upright clustered feathers with tapered points flaring lower LEFT, gold root curls toward lower RIGHT. 2 top-center raw slot 01, partly open single left wing, width 0.84 × height (about 327×390). Flat swept feathers fan to LEFT from upper right rounded shoulder; bottom feathers drop to the lower left and curled root is to lower RIGHT. 3 top-right raw slot 02, full swept single left wing, width 0.74 × height (about 295×400). Two sharply upturned LEFT flame-tip shapes in upper half and others fanned toward LEFT; gold curl low on RIGHT.
4 middle-left raw slot 04, expanded bilateral pair, width 1.48 × height (about 400×270). Upward curled tips spread out far left and right, lower points drop. A broad empty central U, with the two gold ruyi curls approaching each other near the bottom but a narrow visible transparent gap between them. No connecting bridge or mount. 5 middle-center raw slot 05, medium bilateral pair, width 1.67 × height (about 400×239). Upper tips flatter and sweep outward horizontally, pronounced row of feathers falling to each side, two inward gold curls separated near the lower center, big clear gap above. 6 middle-right raw slot 06, narrowed upright bilateral pair, width 1.21 × height (about 400×331). Two almost upright feather stacks with rounded top and some trailing lower feathers, tiny inward curls near bottom, substantial open U through the middle.
7 bottom-left raw slot 08, narrow upright single RIGHT wing, width 0.60 × height, reverse of slot 00. Rounded top, upright clustered feathers with tapered points flaring lower RIGHT, gold root curls toward lower LEFT. 8 bottom-center raw slot 09, partly open single RIGHT wing, width 0.84 × height, reverse of slot 01. Flat swept feathers fan to RIGHT from upper left rounded shoulder, bottom feathers drop lower right, gold curl low on LEFT. 9 bottom-right raw slot 10, full swept single RIGHT wing, width 0.74 × height, reverse of slot 02. Two sharply upturned RIGHT flame-tip shapes in upper half and other feathers fan RIGHT, curled gold root low on LEFT.

Always one single half per top or bottom cell and exactly two halves per middle cell. Strong difference between narrow, partly open and expanded poses. Use no uniform glow; draw sharply distinct physical feather edge silhouettes, comfortable open clear cell margins and the true transparent gaps.
